[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The instance profile is configured with a computed role name rather than a reference to the managed IAM role. It can therefore be created before the role exists, although AWS requires the role to exist before it can be added to the profile.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
`:resource.aws_iam_instance_profile.instance` sets its `role` through a local string, so Terraform does not order profile creation after `:resource.aws_iam_role.instance`; AWS requires the role to exist before adding it to the profile.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The instance profile is configured with a literal/local role name rather than a reference to the managed role. When create_runner_iam_role is enabled, the profile can be created before the role exists; reference the role so Terraform orders role creation first.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The launch template names the runner instance profile using a local value, so Terraform can create it and the Auto Scaling group can launch instances before the managed instance profile exists. Reference the profile resource directly when it is managed.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The launch template supplies the instance profile by a locally computed name, so Terraform does not wait for the profile resource. The profile must exist before instances launched from this template can use it.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
`:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance` can launch its runner instance before `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy.instance` is installed, so instance startup can run without its configured CloudWatch permissions.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The ASG may start the runner before the inline CloudWatch logging policy is attached to its instance role. The launch template references only the instance profile/role, not this policy; wait for the policy before launching instances so bootstrap logging has its required permissions.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
`:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance` can launch before `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm` is attached, so runner-token management permissions may not be ready when the instance starts.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
When token management is enabled, runner user data manages the SSM parameter value, but the ASG can launch before the instance-role SSM policy attachment completes. Add ordering so the runner has the required SSM permissions during bootstrap.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
`:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance` can launch before `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.eip` is attached, so the agent may lack its configured EIP-assignment permission at startup.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
When EIP support is enabled, runner user data assigns the EIP, but the ASG can launch before the EIP policy attachment is available on its instance role. Order ASG creation after this attachment so the bootstrap association does not race policy setup.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
`:module.terminate_instances_lifecycle_function:resource.aws_cloudwatch_event_target.terminate_instances` can make the rule's Lambda target active before `:module.terminate_instances_lifecycle_function:resource.aws_lambda_permission.unqualified_alias_triggers` grants EventBridge permission to invoke the unqualified function ARN.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The EventBridge target invokes the unqualified Lambda ARN, but Terraform does not order target creation after the unqualified invoke permission. Ensure the permission is installed before the target can receive matching termination events.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
`:module.terminate_instances_lifecycle_function:resource.aws_lambda_function.terminate_runner_instances` depends on its execution role but not on `:module.terminate_instances_lifecycle_function:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.lambda`; an early invocation may occur before the execution permissions (including log access) are attached.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The Lambda function uses a role whose logging policy is attached separately, and its expected CloudWatch log group is also provisioned separately. The AWS provider documentation recommends ordering function creation after these prerequisites to avoid invocation/logging races.
